notes.title: Patch 2.66
notes.content:
[h1]Map[/h1]

There is now a map for each world. On the map you can also see how many potions and spells you have already found.

[h1]Mysterious Gates[/h1]

Mysterious gates have appeared in world 1 to 3. One day these gates will open under certain conditions.

[h1]Damage Meter[/h1]

The damage scaling is no longer displayed by text, but by a progress bar on the left edge of the screen.


[h1]Optimizations[/h1]

All dynamic lights in World 2 have been converted to static lights and calculated. This should boost World 2's performance.

[h1]Preparations for world 5[/h1]

Patch 2.66 was used to prepare for World 5. You can't see any of that in the game itself, but due to the preparations, World 5 should appear in March.

notes.title: Patch 2.33 A - Shield Spell
notes.content: Upon request, the shield spell has been brought back.

notes.title: Patch 2.33 - New Support system
notes.content:
Support spells are now activated [b]automatically[/b] and consume [b]no mana[/b] anymore. Each support spell has a certain chance to activate. The support spells now last for the entire fight and do not have a timer. Also, some spells have been changed.

[b]Shield Spell[/b]: Has been completely removed from the game and replaced with Rotating Energy. This spell creates four rotating balls of energy around the mage that deal damage on enemy contact.

[b]Holy Peace[/b]: Has been completely removed from the game and replaced with Bouncing Projectile. When this spell is active, when your auto-spells hit, they bounce and fly to the next enemy, dealing damage as well.

[b]Stronger[/b]: This spell now makes you 25% stronger, up from 100%

[b]Gold Spell[/b]: This spell now gives 50% more gold instead of 100%

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
[list]

[*]  The staff menu can now only be called up with the magic stone after world 2 has been completed.

[*]  The rocks that the golems throw now have a particle effect for better visibility.

notes.title: Content Update 1 + Give Away
notes.content:
[h1]World 4[/h1]

World 4 is entirely devoted to the new mode. Players will face different challenges to overcome in 5 levels. At the end there is a new wand as a reward. In future worlds, this mode will appear again and again, but never alone like in world 4, but as a bonus path that will be marked with two stars.

[h1]Changes and Updates[/h1]

[list]
[*] Wands can now only be selected after completing world 2.
[*] The wand menu can now be controlled with the controller
[/list]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

Before moving on to World 5, some elements will be changed.

[list]
[*]  Support system is changed to have more use.
[*]  Gems are added, which give bonuses to the magician.
[*]  Performance will be improved, especially in World. 2.
[*]  no hit run
[/list]

notes.title: Wands and BUG fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Wands[/h1]

You can now choose magic wands, each with 6 different values. Later wands that come with the Land of Madness mode will also have special extras.

[h1]Land of Madness Release?[/h1]

I still think before 2022, but as a solo developer I can't make any promises.

[h1]Innovations[/h1]

- There is now an FPS lock between infinity and 144 FPS.
- Vertical synchronization has been added.
- Audio and language are now saved in a separate memory file so that when the game is reset, these things don't always have to be setup.
- When starting for the first time, the audio settings are now much quieter.
- You can now close the menus with Escape.
- The camera at the magic stone can now be rotated freely.

[h1]Troubleshooting[/h1]

- In many places you can no longer fall through the ground.
- In world 1 there are 13 bottles instead of 12 to collect.
- The boss in world 1 should no longer be stuck.
- Audio settings do not reset after resuscitation.

notes.title: Tutorial
notes.content:
[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
In World 1, a message will now appear stating that you have to hold down the spell key to cast a spell.

Also in world 1, a message is now displayed when the mana is full and the auto attack no longer causes damage. 

[h2] General [/h2]
The game can now be minimized properly (Alt + TAB)

notes.title: Endless game over music loop
notes.content: A bug where the music in the Game Over screen was played endlessly has now been fixed.
